scorecard.promise: Going-out business losses to breakeven in 4-6 quarters
scorecard.quote: we now expect the losses to come down sequentially from here towards breakeven in the next four to six quarters.
scorecard.outcome: Tracking; 3 quarters have passed. Consolidated PAT remains positive at ₹125 Cr in Sep 2026, but segment-specific breakeven is not shown.

scorecard.promise: Inventory model shift benefit within 6-9 months, max 1%
scorecard.quote: the full benefit should accrue in the next six to nine months, and the benefit will not be more than 1%.
scorecard.outcome: Blinkit inventory losses reported at 1.8% of NOV in Jul 2026, suggesting the 1% benefit cap or target is still in progress.

scorecard.quote: We've given overall guidance of 60% CAGR and that would obviously mean some reasonable store expansion
scorecard.outcome: Revenue grew from ₹12,114 Cr (Mar 2024) to ₹54,364 Cr (Mar 2026), representing a CAGR well above 60%.

scorecard.promise: Capex per store to remain lower than INR 2.5 crore
scorecard.quote: If you therefore look at our capex over the last six months... it is lower than INR 2.5 crore. We expect that to continue going forward.
scorecard.outcome: Specific per-store capex figures are not provided in the quarterly financial tables or subsequent reported metrics.

scorecard.promise: Food delivery margins to remain flattish for 1-2 years
scorecard.quote: broadly, over the next 1 or 2 years, we expect the margins to remain flattish.
scorecard.outcome: Consolidated OPM was 2.9% in Jun 2026 and 3.1% in Sep 2026. Too early to judge the 1-2 year horizon.

scorecard.promise: NOV growth to pick up starting December quarter YoY
scorecard.quote: we expect that NOV growth should pick up starting the December quarter on a YoY basis.
scorecard.outcome: The December 2026 (Q3 FY27) results are not yet available in the provided data.

credibility.summary: Management demonstrates conservative revenue forecasting, significantly exceeding their 60% CAGR target. However, many operational targets (working capital, store capex) lack transparency in standard financial reporting.

narrative_vs_numbers: Revenue growth narrative is consistently exceeded by actuals, with FY26 revenue jumping over 150% vs the 60% CAGR guide.
The narrative of 'trending up' margins aligns with OPM rising from 1.2% (Mar 2025) to 3.1% (Sep 2026).
Inventory model benefits (narrative <1%) conflict with reported inventory losses of 1.8% in Q1 FY27.
Consolidated PAT remains positive (₹125 Cr) supporting the narrative of loss reduction across business segments.
